page: Amazon Web Services g4dn.12xlarge is an accelerated computing instance hosted on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The system is equipped with a 24-core, 48-vCPU Intel Xeon 8259CL processor based on the x86_64 architecture operating at 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 192.0 GB of DDR4 RAM running at 3 GHz, providing an even 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered by four NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs with an aggregate total of 64 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities feature a 50 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and local high-speed scratch space is provided via a bundled 900 GB NVMe SSD.

Benchmark results demonstrate specialized acceleration for parallelized compute tasks. In large language model evaluations, the quad-T4 configuration yields top-tier prompt processing throughput across small, medium, and large model architectures, maintaining over 1,000 tokens per second on 7B models. Token generation remains strong on medium models. Conversely, general CPU-bound performance is moderate: single-core execution speeds in stress-ng reflect weak bottom-quartile ratings, while Geekbench multi-core scores, PassMark CPU indices, and compilation benchmarks align with median enterprise expectations. Memory bandwidth and static web serving throughput also demonstrate standard mid-tier performance.

By bundling four dedicated graphics processors alongside 48 dedicated compute threads, g4dn.12xlarge provides dense GPU-to-CPU resources without requiring discrete host clustering. This configuration offers solid cost efficiency for parallel inference and media processing, offsetting modest single-core CPU speeds with high accelerator throughput. It is specifically suited for distributed machine learning inference, real-time video transcoding, batch image processing, and remote graphics rendering pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services g4dn.12xlarge is an accelerated computing instance designed for GPU-intensive workloads and high-throughput inference. Powered by the Nitro hypervisor, the platform features a 24-core Intel Xeon 8259CL processor delivering 48 dedicated vCPUs at 2.5 GHz, paired with 192.0 GB of DDR4 memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs supplying 64 GB of aggregate VRAM. Local ephemeral storage consists of a 900 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 50 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark evaluations highlight top-tier prompt processing performance in small, medium, and large language model inference workloads, alongside strong 7B text generation rates. While CPU single-core performance remains modest, multi-core computational throughput and memory bandwidth score solidly in the mid-range. The g4dn.12xlarge is engineered for machine learning inference pipelines, video transcoding, multi-GPU rendering, and graphics-intensive enterprise applications requiring multi-accelerator density.
